text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is one report of acute overdosage with testosterone enanthate injection: testosterone levels of up to 11,400 ng/dL were implicated in a cerebrovascular accident. Oral ingestion of Striant is not expected to result in clinically significant serum testosterone concentrations due to extensive first-pass (hepatic) metabolism. Treatment of overdosage would consist of discontinuation of Striant together with appropriate symptomatic and supportive care.
